title: Construction of finite matching limits
statement: For a quasi compact quasi separated scheme X and a finite truncated simplicial diagram S of quasi compact quasi separated etale X schemes, TruncatedEtaleMatchingData X r S exists. The notions used here are those of [def-weil-pbc-truncated-etale-matching-data].

source.place: Detailed form proof: finite simplicial data and finite matching limits

proof.text: Use the finite instance for the truncated simplex category supplied by the caller. In the descent proof it is the existing truncated_finite theorem of Sheaf.Paper.FiniteHypercoverDescentParts; no duplicate finiteness lemma is needed. The full subcategory of qcqs etale X schemes has a terminal object and pullbacks. Its inclusion in Over X preserves finite limits. For n take the limit of the finite boundary category of arrows from lower dimensional simplices to n. The limit projections and the cone from S_n provide the required maps and universal property, including the empty boundary in degree zero.
